title: AIIMS Delhi Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 05 Project Research Scientist and Project Technical Support Posts
description: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) has announced the official notification for the recruitment of 05 Project Research Scientist I, III and Project Technical Support I, II, III positions. Candidates with an MDS, BDS, Any Degree, postgraduation, 10th Pass, or diploma can use this chance and apply for the AIIMS Delhi Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for thes...
